claims.title: DESI DR2 BAO: hint of evolving dark energy
claims.title_zh: DESI DR2 重子声学振荡：暗能量演化的迹象
claims.statement: DESI DR2 BAO combined with CMB and type Ia supernovae prefers w0waCDM (w0 > -1, wa < 0) over LambdaCDM at 2.8-4.2 sigma depending on the SN sample.
claims.statement_zh: DESI DR2 重子声学振荡（BAO）数据与宇宙微波背景（CMB）和 Ia 型超新星结合后，相对 ΛCDM 更偏好 w0waCDM（w0 > -1，wa < 0），显著性为 2.8–4.2σ，取决于所用的超新星样本。

quantities.name: Delta chi2_MAP, DESI + compressed CMB prior
quantities.ours: -8.01 (reading B, omega_bc = omega_b + omega_c); -6.59 (reading A, with omega_nu)

quantities.name: Delta chi2_MAP, DESI alone / + Pantheon+ / + Union3

updates: 2026: DES-Dovekie SN recalibration lowers the DES-SN combination from 4.2 to ~3.2 sigma (Popovic et al., arXiv:2511.07517).
2026-07: DESI DR2 Lya full-shape gives 2.7 sigma (DESI+CMB) and 3.2 sigma (with SNe) (arXiv:2607.27410).
open_questions: How much of the preference comes from the w0-wa parametrisation versus binned w(z) or Gaussian-process reconstructions?
Leave-one-tracer-out and leave-one-SN-sample-out sensitivity of the signal.
claims.notes: Verified against arXiv abstracts in plan 002 (cosmology agent report, 2026-11-11). Milestone M1. Study 002 (2026-11-14): BAO-only and no-CMB rows reproduced, compressed-CMB row conditionally reproduced; full-CMB and DES-SN5YR rows are out of scope (full Planck/ACT likelihoods; 53.5 MB covariance above the download limit). The compressed prior reproduces when its omega_bc mean is read as omega_b + omega_c (-8.01) but not with omega_nu added (-6.59); the referee pointed out that the split may lie within the (unmeasured) theta_* calibration systematics, so the convention is left open (T-022).

claims.title: The Milky Way's thick disk began forming ~13 Gyr ago
claims.title_zh: 银河系厚盘约 13 Gyr 前开始形成
claims.statement: Precise ages of ~250,000 subgiants (LAMOST x Gaia) show the old disk started forming ~13 Gyr ago, ~2 Gyr before the inner halo finished assembling, with a star-formation peak ~11 Gyr ago around the Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus merger.
claims.statement_zh: 约 25 万颗亚巨星（LAMOST × Gaia）的精确年龄表明，老年盘约 13 Gyr 前开始形成，比内晕完成组装早约 2 Gyr；恒星形成峰值约在 11 Gyr 前，与盖亚-香肠-恩克拉多斯（Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus）并合同期。
open_questions: Robustness of the onset epoch to the isochrone grid.
claims.notes: Milestone M5. Updated catalog: 320,028 subgiants (NADC DOI 10.12149/101467); download only the needed columns.

claims.title: Dormant stellar-mass black holes found by Gaia astrometry
claims.title_zh: Gaia 天体测量发现的休眠恒星级黑洞
claims.statement: Gaia astrometric orbits plus RV follow-up reveal non-interacting black holes orbiting normal stars: BH1 (9.6 Msun), BH2 (8.9 Msun) and BH3 (32.7 Msun).
claims.statement_zh: Gaia 天体测量轨道加上视向速度（RV）后续观测，发现了绕普通恒星运行、无相互作用（不发生物质交流）的黑洞：BH1（9.6 M☉）、BH2（8.9 M☉）和 BH3（32.7 M☉）。

sources.cite: Gaia Collaboration, Panuzzo et al. 2024, A&A 686, L2 (Gaia BH3)

quantities.name: M_BH (BH3)
quantities.note: no DR3 orbit; paper table or DR4

quantities.name: El-Badry+24 NS candidates recovered by server-side screen

open_questions: Systematic DR4 screen of NSS orbits for dark companions > 3 Msun on release day (2026-12-02).
Does the NS-BH mass gap survive DR4 orbits?

claims.title: Binary black hole mass spectrum features (GWTC-4.0)
claims.statement: The BBH primary-mass distribution steepens above ~35 Msun with overdensities near ~10 and ~35 Msun (and a possible ~20 Msun feature); GW231123 lies in or across the pair-instability gap.
claims.statement_zh: 双黑洞（BBH）主星质量分布在约 35 M☉ 以上变陡，在约 10 和约 35 M☉ 处存在过密峰（并可能在约 20 M☉ 处有特征）；GW231123 落在对不稳定性质量间隙之内或跨越该间隙。
open_questions: Robustness of the 35 Msun feature to pairing-function choices, using released summaries only.
claims.notes: Milestone M10. The population data release is 35 GB; use only the small files and the GWOSC event table. The ~20 Msun feature is only a hint.

claims.title: Hubble tension: local distance ladder vs early universe
claims.title_zh: 哈勃张力：本地距离阶梯与早期宇宙
claims.statement: Cepheid-calibrated distance-ladder H0 (~73 km/s/Mpc) exceeds the CMB-inferred LCDM value (~67-68) at >5 sigma; TRGB/JAGB calibrations (CCHP) give ~70.
claims.statement_zh: 造父变星定标的距离阶梯给出的 H0（约 73 km/s/Mpc）高于 CMB 推断的 ΛCDM 值（约 67–68），差异显著性超过 5σ；TRGB/JAGB 定标（CCHP）给出约 70。

sources.cite: Riess et al. 2024/25, JWST validates HST distances

open_questions: Is the CCHP-SH0ES difference a calibrator-host selection effect?

claims.title: Spectroscopically confirmed galaxies at z ~ 14 and the bright-galaxy excess
claims.title_zh: 光谱确认的 z ≈ 14 星系与亮星系过剩
claims.statement: JWST spectroscopy confirms luminous galaxies at z = 14.32 (JADES-GS-z14-0) and z = 14.44 (MoM-z14); the bright-end UV luminosity function at z > 10 exceeds pre-JWST model predictions.
claims.statement_zh: JWST 光谱确认了 z = 14.32（JADES-GS-z14-0）和 z = 14.44（MoM-z14）的高光度星系；z > 10 的亮端紫外光度函数超出 JWST 之前的模型预测。
open_questions: Minimal UV burstiness / star-formation efficiency needed at z ~ 12-15.
claims.notes: Milestone M8. Detection is established; the interpretation of the excess is contested.

claims.title: Declining outer rotation curve of the Milky Way
claims.title_zh: 银河系外区旋转曲线下降
claims.statement: Gaia DR3-based rotation curves decline beyond ~15-20 kpc (about 30 km/s from 19.5 to 26.5 kpc), implying a lighter Galaxy (~2e11 Msun); the Keplerian interpretation is disputed.
claims.statement_zh: 基于 Gaia DR3 的旋转曲线在约 15–20 kpc 以外下降（从 19.5 到 26.5 kpc 下降约 30 km/s），意味着银河系质量较小（约 2×10¹¹ M☉）；开普勒式下降的解释存在争议。
open_questions: Joint propagation of Jeans-modelling systematics (cross-term, disequilibrium, disk scale length).

claims.title: Nanohertz gravitational-wave background from pulsar timing arrays
claims.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列探测到的纳赫兹引力波背景
claims.statement: NANOGrav, EPTA, PPTA and CPTA find a common red process with Hellings-Downs correlations at ~2-4.6 sigma, consistent with a GW background of amplitude ~2.4e-15 at f = 1/yr.
claims.statement_zh: NANOGrav、EPTA、PPTA 和 CPTA 发现了具有 Hellings-Downs 相关性的共同红噪声过程，显著性约 2–4.6σ，与 f = 1/yr 处振幅约 2.4×10⁻¹⁵ 的引力波背景一致。

sources.cite: Antoniadis et al. 2023, A&A 678, A50 (EPTA DR2)

open_questions: Is the SMBHB amplitude consistent with galaxy-merger and BH mass-function priors?
claims.notes: Milestone M9. Grade 'hint' here means strong evidence below 5 sigma. Use the NANOGrav KDE free-spectrum release (Zenodo 10344086, v1.1.0).

claims.title: S8 tension between weak lensing and the CMB
claims.title_zh: 弱引力透镜与 CMB 之间的 S8 张力
claims.statement: Low-redshift probes of clustering amplitude (S8) were lower than the CMB-inferred value; by 2025-26 KiDS-Legacy is consistent with the CMB while DES Y6 remains ~2.6 sigma low.
claims.statement_zh: 低红移的成团幅度（S8）探针曾低于 CMB 推断值；到 2025–26 年，KiDS-Legacy 已与 CMB 一致，而 DES Y6 仍偏低约 2.6σ。

claims.title: Wide binaries as a test of gravity at low acceleration
claims.title_zh: 用宽双星检验低加速度下的引力
claims.statement: Gaia DR3 wide-binary relative velocities test MOND vs Newton below a0; large clean samples favour Newtonian gravity, while small high-precision samples are claimed to show a MOND-like boost.
claims.statement_zh: Gaia DR3 宽双星的相对速度可在加速度低于 a0 时检验 MOND 与牛顿引力；大而干净的样本支持牛顿引力，而有研究声称小的高精度样本显示出类 MOND 的增强。

sources.cite: Cookson, Banik, El-Badry et al. 2026, MNRAS

open_questions: Blind quality-ladder reanalysis reproducing both groups' cuts in one pipeline.
Hidden close binaries flagged with DR4 epoch astrometry.
claims.notes: Milestone M7. Do not download the 1.8 GB El-Badry catalog; rebuild the sample server-side.

studies.title: Smoke test: Gaia DR3 census of the 10 pc neighbourhood
studies.title_zh: 冒烟测试：Gaia DR3 的 10 pc 邻域普查
studies.question: Does the pipeline (guarded TAP, cache, provenance, server-side aggregation, web page) work end to end?
studies.question_zh: 管线（受守卫的 TAP 查询、缓存、来源记录、服务器端聚合、网页）能否端到端运行？

studies.title: M4: Gaia dormant black holes - DR3 reproduction and DR4-ready screen
studies.title_zh: M4：Gaia 休眠黑洞——DR3 复现与面向 DR4 的筛选
studies.question: Can DR3 NSS astrometric orbits alone reproduce Gaia BH1/BH2 masses, and can a server-side screen recover known dormant compact objects, ready for DR4?
studies.question_zh: 仅凭 DR3 非单星（NSS）天体测量轨道能否复现 Gaia BH1/BH2 的质量？服务器端筛选能否找回已知的休眠致密天体，并为 DR4 做好准备？

scale.note: Galactic, solar neighbourhood to a few kpc

studies.title: DESI DR2 BAO and evolving dark energy
studies.title_zh: DESI DR2 重子声学振荡与演化暗能量
studies.question: Do DESI DR2 BAO distances, alone and combined with a compressed CMB prior or supernovae, prefer evolving dark energy (w0waCDM) over a cosmological constant, and how strongly?
studies.question_zh: DESI DR2 的 BAO 距离单独使用、或与压缩 CMB 先验及超新星组合时，是否偏好演化暗能量（w0waCDM）而非宇宙学常数，偏好有多强？

scale.note: BAO comoving distances z = 0.1-2.3 (~0.4-5.7 Gpc) out to the CMB distance (~14 Gpc)

survey.name: DESI DR2
survey.note: BAO from the DESI spectroscopic footprint; the CMB prior and SN compilations are all-sky
